appliedUpdates.description: Added guidance to reseed/restart after temporary-ban events during blocked-model probes and documented external prerequisite dependencies for provider/MCP assertions.

frictions.description: After API and UI login activity, browser login attempts began returning 'Too many login attempts in a short amount of time' on /login.
frictions.resolution: Used current API evidence for role/permission assertions, reused same-mission r2 UI captures for superadmin/workspace model-selector/admin-menu evidence, and reseeded personas to restore baseline identities.

frictions.description: agent-browser network-idle waits timed out intermittently on dev rail; fixed waits were required for deterministic screenshots.
frictions.resolution: Used agent-browser wait 5000 before capture; collected screenshots successfully.

frictions.description: Model-enforcement probe requests on agent/chat surfaces triggered violation handling (Illegal request -> temporary ban), interrupting deeper probe sequence.
frictions.resolution: Reduced probe volume, restored user model permissions, and marked remaining matrix coverage blocked.

frictions.description: Federated auth surfaces were disabled in /api/config, preventing required federated/auto-provisioned validation path execution.
frictions.resolution: Captured config evidence and marked VAL-MODEL-001 blocked for that missing path.

frictions.description: Initial API probe without browser UA triggered NON_BROWSER violation and subsequent temporary-ban responses on seeded personas.
frictions.resolution: Switched to browser surface and browser-like UA for probes, but ban state persisted for file/transcription routes.

frictions.description: agent-browser network requests returned no captured entries for this session.
frictions.resolution: Used curl status captures and browser console logs as fallback network evidence.

frictions.description: MCP server title validation rejected hyphenated titles during setup.
frictions.resolution: Retried with titles containing only letters/numbers/spaces.

frictions.description: Validation required temporary user-scoped MCP server creation to probe schema and connection behavior.
frictions.resolution: Created `local-mcp-8765` and `local-mcp-8766`, collected evidence, then deleted both servers to restore prior state.

frictions.description: agent-browser network capture was initially sparse and required a later explicit export pass to capture chat routes.

frictions.description: Menu-triggered file-picker flow (Upload for File Search) was not directly automatable via menuitem ref upload in agent-browser.

frictions.description: agent-browser wait --load networkidle timed out on login page due continuous background activity.
frictions.resolution: Switched to fixed waits and URL/text waits for deterministic flow control.
